// ================================================================
// Gráficos SVG — sem dependências externas (funciona offline)
// Compatível com navegadores modernos (Chrome/Edge/Safari recentes)
// ================================================================

'use strict';

const PALETTE = [
  '#4f46e5','#3b82f6','#22c55e','#16a34a','#a855f7','#ec4899',
  '#f59e0b','#14b8a6','#06b6d4','#8b5cf6','#d97706','#65a30d'
];
const TXT = '#94a3b8';

/* ---------- helpers ---------- */
const EL = (tag, id, attrs = {}, cls) => {
  const e = document.createElement(tag);
  if (id) e.id = id;
  for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(attrs)) e.setAttribute(k, v);
  if (cls) (Array.isArray(cls) ? cls : [cls]).forEach(c => e.classList.add(c));
  return e;
};

function viewBoxCoords(svg) {
  const m = svg.getAttribute('viewBox').match(/^([-+]?\d*)\s+([-+]?\d*)\s+([-+]?\d*)\s+([-+]?\d*)$/);
  if (!m || m.length < 4) m = ['0', '0', '800', '500'];
  return [+m[0], +m[1], +m[2] - +m[0], +m[3] - +m[1]];
}

function injectEmpty(container) {
  const d = container.querySelector('.msg-empty');
  if (!d) {
    d = EL('div', 'msg-empty');
    d.style.cssText = 'position:absolute;inset:0;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;' +
                     'color:var(--c-muted);font-weight:600;font-size:.92rem';
    container.appendChild(d);
  }
  return d;
}

// ---------------------------- barras agrupadas (mensal) ----------------------------
export function drawBares(container, dados) {
  const svg = container.querySelector('svg');
  if (!svg) return;
  const {x0,y0,x1,y1} = viewBoxCoords(svg);
  const W = x1-x0, H = y1-y0, pad = 30;
  const iw = W - 2*pad;
  const tops = dados.map(d => Math.max(d.receita || 0, d.despesa || 0));
  const maxY = Math.max(...tops) * 1.12 || 120;
  const y = v => y0 + H - (v / maxY) * H;        // cresce PARA BAIXO (zero no topo)
  const step = iw / (dados.length - 1 || 1);
  const items = dados.map((d, i) => ({
    nome: d.period, top: Math.max(d.receita || 0, d.despesa || 0),
    rec: d.receita || 0, des: d.despesa || 0,
    x: x0 + pad + step / 2 + i * step
  }));

  // --- linhas de grade horizontais
  const gg = svg.querySelector('g.gridLines') || EL('g', 'gridLines'); gg.id = 'gridLines';
  for (let i = 0; i <= 4; i++) {
    const lv = y0 + H * (i / 4);
    const yy = y(lv);
    const p = EL('path', `gl-${i}`);
    p.setAttribute('d', `${pad} ${yy} ${x1} ${yy}`);
    p.setAttribute('stroke','#161e2e'); p.setAttribute('stroke-dasharray','3 3');
    gg.appendChild(p);
  }

  // --- rótulos do eixo X (mês) — girados 45°
  const xtG = svg.querySelector('g.xtick') || EL('g', 'xtick'); xtG.id = 'xtick';
  items.forEach(({x, nome}) => {
    const t = EL('text', `mt-${nome.replace(/\s+/g, '-')}`);
    t.textContent = nome;
    t.setAttribute('font-size','8.4px'); t.setAttribute('fill',TXT);
    t.setAttribute('text-anchor','middle');
    t.setAttribute('y', y1 - 3);
    t.setAttribute('transform', `rotate(45deg)`);
    xtG.appendChild(t);
    const tw = t.measureText(nome).width + 4;
  });

  // --- barras
  const bg = svg.querySelector('g.bars') || EL('g', 'bars'); bg.id = 'bars';
  let barW = 7.5;
  items.forEach(it => {
    const recH = y(it.rec) - y0;
    const desH = y(it.des) - y0;

    // receita (verde) — primeira, traçada por baixo
    const r = EL('rect', `bar-rec-${it.nome.replace(/\s+/g, '-')}`);
    r.setAttribute('width', `${barW}px`); r.setAttribute('height', `${recH.toFixed(1)}px`);
    r.setAttribute('x', (it.x - barW / 2).toFixed(1)); r.setAttribute('y', y0.toFixed(1));
    r.setAttribute('fill','#22c55e'); r.setAttribute('opacity','0.95');
    bg.appendChild(r);

    // despesa (vermelha) — por cima
    const dr = EL('rect', `bar-des-${it.nome.replace(/\s+/g, '-')}`);
    dr.setAttribute('width', `${barW}px`); dr.setAttribute('height', `${desH.toFixed(1)}px`);
    dr.setAttribute('x', (it.x - barW / 2).toFixed(1)); dr.setAttribute('y', y0.toFixed(1));
    dr.setAttribute('fill','#ef4444'); dr.setAttribute('opacity','0.85');
    bg.appendChild(dr);

    // rótulo de valor na barra maior
    const taller = Math.max(it.rec, it.des);
    const clr = taller === it.rec ? '#22c55e' : '#ef4444';
    const labelTxt = `${it.nome.split(' ')[0]} · R$ ${fmtBR2(taller)}`;
    const labelW = it.nome.length * 4.4 + 14;
    let lx = it.x + 12;
    if (lx + labelW > x1 - 40) lx = it.x - labelW - 30;
    if (lx < x0 - 90) return;  // cortado dos dois lados
    const lt = EL('text', `lbl-${it.nome.replace(/\s+/g, '-')}`);
    lt.textContent = labelTxt;
    lt.setAttribute('font-size','7.6px'); lt.setAttribute('fill',clr);
    lt.setAttribute('font-weight','600');
    lt.setAttribute('rotateAxis','origin');
    lt.setAttribute('transform', `rotate(90deg)`);
    lt.setAttribute('x', lx); lt.setAttribute('y', y0 - 2);
    svg.appendChild(lt);
  });

  // --- tooltip (passa o mouse sobre o gráfico)
  const tp = document.getElementById('tt-mensal') || EL('div', 'tt-mensal');
  tp.style.cssText = `position:absolute;pointer-events:none;z-index:30;
    background:var(--c-surface2);border:1px solid var(--c-border);border-radius:8px;
    padding:6px 8px;font-size:.8rem;line-height:1.5;color:var(--c-text);
    box-shadow:0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.4);white-space:nowrap;max-width:210px`;
  svg.addEventListener('mouseenter', () => tp.hidden = false);
  svg.addEventListener('mouseleave', () => { tp.hidden = true; });
  svg.addEventListener('mousemove', e => {
    if (tp.hidden) return;
    const mx = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (e.clientX - e.offsetLeft) / W));
    const idx = Math.min(dados.length - 1, Math.round((mx * 1000) / Math.max(step, 1)));
    const m = dados[idx] || null;
    if (!m) { tp.hidden = true; return; }
    const rec = m.receita || 0; const desp = m.despesa || 0;
    const txt = `${m.nome.toUpperCase()} · Entradas R$ ${fmtBR2(rec)} · Saídas R$ ${fmtBR2(desp)} · Saldo R$ ${fmtBR2(rec - desp)}`;
    const cr = container.getBoundingClientRect();
    let l = e.clientX - cr.left + 150;
    let t = e.clientY - cr.top - 46;
    l = Math.min(l, cr.width - 210);
    if (t + 30 > cr.height - 60) { l -= 200; t = Math.max(t, 8); }
    tp.style.left = l + 'px'; tp.style.top = t + 'px'; tp.textContent = txt;
  });
}

// ---------------------------- rosca (donut) ------------------------------------
export function drawRosca(container, categorias) {
  const svg = container.querySelector('svg');
  if (!svg) return;
  const {x0,y0,x1,y1} = viewBoxCoords(svg);
  const W = x1-x0, H = y1-y0, pad = 26;
  const vx = x0 + pad, vy = y0 + (y1-y0)/2 - 16;
  const R = Math.min(W, H) * 0.42 - pad - 8;
  if (!categorias.length) { injectEmpty(container); return; }

  const total = categorias.reduce((a, c) => a + (c.receita || 0) + (c.despesa || 0), 0) || 1;
  const pal = [...PALETTE].slice(0, Math.min(categorias.length, 10));
  const ord = [...categorias].sort((a, b) => (b.receita || 0) + b.despesa - (a.receita || 0) - (a.despesa || 0), 0);

  const grp = svg.querySelector('g.donut') || EL('g', 'donut'); grp.id = 'donut';
  let ang = 0;

  ord.forEach((c, i) => {
    const tot = (c.receita || 0) + (c.despesa || 0);
    const deg = tot / total * 360;
    const a1 = ang * Math.PI / 180;
    const a2 = (ang + deg / 180) * Math.PI;
    const mid = (a1 + a2) / 2;
    const rh = R - 0.34 * R;                     // raio do buraco central
    const ox = vx + rh * Math.cos(mid), oy = vy + rh * Math.sin(mid);
    const ri = 0.34 * R;

    const sweep = deg >= 0 ? 1 : -1;
    const x1a = vx + R * Math.cos(a1), y1a = vy + R * Math.sin(a1);
    const x2a = vx + R * Math.cos(a2), y2a = vy + R * Math.sin(a2);

    // arco externo (setor)
    const outPath = `M ${x1a} ${y1a} A ${R} ${R} 0 1 ${sweep} ${x2a} ${y2a} L ${vx+R*Math.cos(a1)} ${vy+R*Math.sin(a1)} Z`;
    // arco interno (buraco)
    const x3 = ox + ri * Math.cos(a2), y3 = oy + ri * Math.sin(a2);
    const x4 = ox + ri * Math.cos(a1), y4 = oy + ri * Math.sin(a1);
    const inPath = `M ${x3} ${y3} A ${ri} ${ri} 0 -1 ${-sweep} ${x4} ${y4} Z`;

    const clip = EL('clipPath', `cl-${i || 0}`); clip.setAttribute('clipRule', 'evenodd');
    clip.appendChild(EL('path', '', 'cpo', {}, outPath));
    clip.appendChild(EL('path', '', 'cop', {}, inPath));
    svg.appendChild(clip);

    const arc = EL('path', `ar-${i}`);
    arc.setAttribute('d', outPath);
    arc.setAttribute('fill', pal[i % pal.length]);
    arc.setAttribute('stroke','#0f1117'); arc.setAttribute('stroke-width','1.5');
    grp.appendChild(arc);

    // rótulo percentual fora do setor
    const ta = a2 + Math.PI / 6;
    const lx = vx + (R + 14) * Math.cos(ta), ly = vy + (R + 14) * Math.sin(ta);
    const lt = EL('text', `lg-${i}`);
    let txt = c.nome.split(' ')[0] + ' · ';
    const pct = tot / total * 100;
    if ((c.receita || c.despesa || 0) <= 0) txt += 'NEG';
    else txt += `${pct.toFixed(1)}%`;
    lt.textContent = txt;
    lt.setAttribute('x', lx + 3, 'x'); lt.setAttribute('y', ly - 3, 'y');
    lt.setAttribute('transform', `rotate(-${a2 * 180 / Math.PI}deg)`);
    lt.setAttribute('font-size','9px'); lt.setAttribute('fill','#cbd5e1');
    lt.setAttribute('font-weight','600');
    grp.appendChild(lt);
    ang = a2;
  });

  // legenda
  const leg = document.getElementById('leg-internal') || injectLeg(container);
  const items = ord.map(c => ({
    nome: c.nome, total: (c.receita || c.despesa || 0),
    rec: c.receita || 0, des: c.despesa || 0
  }));
  appendLegend(items, leg, total);
}

function injectLeg(container) {
  const d = document.getElementById('leg-internal');
  if (!d) {
    d = EL('div', 'leg-internal');
    d.style.cssText = `position:absolute;right:12px;bottom:12px;z-index:13;
      background:var(--c-surface2);border:1px solid var(--c-border);border-radius:10px;
      padding:.7rem .9rem;max-width:200px;font-size:8.5px;color:#cbd5e1;opacity:0;visibility:hidden;pointer-events:none;transition:.2s`;
    container.appendChild(d);
  }
  return d;
}

function appendLegend(items, leg, total) {
  const ul = leg.querySelector('ul') || EL('ul', 'legul');
  ul.id = 'leg-internal-ul';
  ul.style.cssText = 'list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0;font-size:8.6px;line-height:1.5';
  items.forEach((it, i) => {
    const li = EL('li', `legitem${i + 1}`);
    const sw = EL('span', '', 'lc', {});
    sw.style.cssText = `width:9px;height:9px;border-radius:50%;flex:0 0 9px;display:inline-block;background:${PAL[i % PAL.length]}`;
    const tx = EL('span', '', 'ltxt', {});
    const s = it.receita + it.despesa;
    let rest = i < items.length - 1 || total === 0 ? ', ' : '';
    let tag = '';
    if (s <= 0) tag = ' (só saídas)';
    else if (it.receita > 0) tag = ' (entradas+saídas)';
    tx.textContent = it.nome + rest + `${(s / total * 100).toFixed(1)}%${tag}`;
    li.appendChild(sw); li.appendChild(tx);
    ul.appendChild(li);
  });
}

// ---------------------------- linha diária ----------------------------------------
export function drawLinha(container, pontos) {
  const svg = container.querySelector('svg');
  if (!svg) return;
  const {x0,y0,x1,y1} = viewBoxCoords(svg);
  const W = x1-x0, H = y1-y0, pad = 30, innerH = H - 60 - 16;
  if (pontos.length < 2) { injectEmpty(container); return; }

  const pts = pontos.map(p => {
    const d = new Date(p[0] + 'T00:00:00');
    return { v: p[1], iso: p[0], idx: Math.floor((d - new Date(pontos[0][0] + 'T00:00:00')).getTime() / 86400000) };
  });

  const mnD = new Date(pts[0].iso + 'T00:00:00');
  const mxD = new Date(pts[pts.length - 1].iso + 'T00:00:00');
  const secs = (mxD - mnD).getTime() / 1000;
  const loSec = mnD.getTime() / 1000 - 180000;  // margem de -30 min
  const hiSec = mxD.getTime() / 1000 + 240000;   // margem de +40 min
  const span = Math.max(hiSec - loSec, 1);
  const xFun = sec => pad + ((sec - loSec) / span) * (W - 2 * pad);
  const yFun = v => pad + innerH * (1 - (v - Math.min(...pts.map(p => p.v))) / (Math.max(...pts.map(p => p.v)) - Math.min(...pts.map(p => p.v)) + 1e-9));

  // linha zero
  const zy = yFun((mnD + mxD) / 2 / 1000);
  const zl = EL('path', '', 'zeroLine');
  zl.setAttribute('d', [xFun(mnD.getTime() / 1000), zy, xFun(mxD.getTime() / 1000), zy].join(' '));
  zl.setAttribute('stroke','#334155'); zl.setAttribute('stroke-dasharray','3 4'); zl.setAttribute('stroke-width','1.2');
  svg.appendChild(zl);

  // área preenchida com gradiente
  const gradDef = svg.querySelector('defs.gradLine') || EL('defs', 'gradL');
  gradDef.innerHTML = '<linearGradient id="gradLine" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="0%" y2="100%"><' +
    'stop offset="0%" stop-color="#60a5fa" stop-opacity="0.12"/>' +
    '<stop offset="100%" stop-color="#ef4444" stop-opacity="0.06"/>' +
    '<stop offset="100%" stop-color="#0f1117" stop-opacity="0"/></linearGradient>';
  const ptsArr = pts.map(p => ({ x: xFun(p.idx), y: yFun(p.v) }));
  const topoEnd = [...ptsArr][ptsArr.length - 1];
  const zeroStart = { x: xFun(pts[0].idx), y: zy };
  const zeroEnd = { x: xFun(pts[pts.length - 1].idx), y: zy };
  const areaPath = [
    ...ptsArr.slice().reverse(),      // do fim de volta ao começo (fecha a área)
    zeroStart, zeroEnd
  ].join(' L ');
  const dEl = EL('path', '', 'areaP');
  dEl.setAttribute('d', areaPath.replace(/,(\s+)/g, ' '));
  dEl.setAttribute('fill','url(#gradLine)');
  const areaG = svg.querySelector('g.area') || EL('g', 'area'); areaG.id = 'area';
  areaG.appendChild(dEl);

  // linhas conectando os pontos (discretas)
  const lG = svg.querySelector('g.lines') || EL('g', 'lines'); lG.id = 'lines';
  for (let i = 1; i < pts.length; i++) {
    const p0 = pts[i - 1], p1 = pts[i];
    const lp = EL('path', `ln-${i}`);
    lp.setAttribute('d', `M ${xFun(p0.idx)} ${yFun(p0.v)} L ${xFun(p1.idx)} ${yFun(p1.v)}`);
    lp.setAttribute('stroke','#94a3b8'); lp.setAttribute('stroke-width','1.6');
    lp.setAttribute('stroke-linecap','round'); lG.appendChild(lp);
  }

  // marcadores início/fim
  const star = EL('circle', '', 'star');
  star.setAttribute('cx', xFun(pts[0].idx)); star.setAttribute('y', yFun(pts[0].v));
  star.setAttribute('r','3.5'); star.setAttribute('fill','#fff'); star.setAttribute('stroke','#3b82f6'); star.setAttribute('stroke-width','2');
  svg.appendChild(star);

  const end = EL('circle', '', 'end');
  end.setAttribute('cx', xFun(pts[pts.length - 1].idx)); end.setAttribute('y', yFun(pts[pts.length - 1].v));
  end.setAttribute('r','3.5'); end.setAttribute('fill','#fff'); end.setAttribute('stroke','#22c55e'); end.setAttribute('stroke-width','2');
  svg.appendChild(end);

  // ticks (a cada ~5 dias)
  const stepDays = Math.max(4, Math.round((mxD - mnD).getTime() / 1000 / 86400));
  const tG = svg.querySelector('g.ticks') || EL('g', 'ticks'); tG.id = 'ticks';
  const t0 = new Date(mnD.getTime());
  let cur = t0;
  while (cur <= mxD) {
    const xx = xFun(Math.floor((cur - mnD.getTime()) / 86400000));
    const vxL = EL('line', '', 'tv');
    vxL.setAttribute('x1', xx); vxL.setAttribute('y1', 0); vxL.setAttribute('x2', xx); vxL.setAttribute('y2', innerH);
    vxL.setAttribute('stroke','#161e2e'); vxL.setAttribute('stroke-width','0.4'); svg.appendChild(vxL);
    const lt = EL('text', `tm-${Math.floor(cur.getMonth())}`);
    lt.textContent = cur.toLocaleDateString('pt-BR', { month: 'short' });
    lt.setAttribute('x', xx + 2, 'x');
    lt.setAttribute('y', y1 + innerH + 8, 'y');
    lt.setAttribute('transform', `rotate(-45deg)`);
    lt.setAttribute('fill','#64748b'); lt.setAttribute('font-size','7.6px');
    tG.appendChild(lt);
    cur = new Date(cur.getTime() + stepDays * 86400000);
  }

  // anotação do maior e do menor valor
  let best = pts[0];
  pts.forEach(p => { const a = p.v !== 0 ? Math.abs(p.v) : 0; if (a > (best.v !== 0 ? Math.abs(best.v) : 0)) best = p; });
  if (best.v !== 0) {
    drawLabel(svg, xFun(best.idx), yFun(best.v), `$${fmtBR2(best.v)}`, '#22c55e', 9, 'bold');
  }
  const minP = pts.reduce((a, b) => a.v < b.v ? a : b);
  if (minP.v < 0) drawLabel(svg, xFun(minP.idx), yFun(minP.v), `$${fmtBR2(minP.v)}`, '#ef4444', 9);
}

function drawLabel(svg, x, y, txt, color, fs, wt) {
  const t = EL('text', 'ann');
  t.textContent = txt;
  t.setAttribute('x', x + 12, 'x'); t.setAttribute('y', y - 8, 'y');
  t.setAttribute('fill', color); t.setAttribute('font-size', fs + 'px');
  t.setAttribute('font-weight', wt || 'normal');
  svg.appendChild(t);
}

// ----------------------------- formatação de valores -------------------------------
function fmtBR2(v) {
  if (isNaN(v)) return '—';
  const s = v.toLocaleString('pt-BR', { signDisplay: 'plusMinus', maximumFractionDigits: 0 });
  return s.replace(/^\+/, '').replace(/\.$/, '');
}

// ------------------------------ inicialização dos gráficos -----------------------
export function initCharts() {
  if (typeof window.__chartsLoaded !== 'boolean' || !window.__chartsLoaded) return;
  drawBares(document.getElementById('chart-mensal'), __charts__.meses);
  drawRosca(document.getElementById('chart-cat'), __charts__.categorias);
  drawLinha(document.getElementById('chart-linha'), __charts__.linha);
  window.__chartsLoaded = true; // reforço de garantia
}

// ================================================================

// ================================================================
'use strict';

// ---------- 1) Carrega o módulo de gráficos (com injeção de fallback) ----------
let __chartsOk = false;
(async () => {
  try { await loadModule('../static/js/charts.js'); __chartsOk = true; }
  catch (e) {
    const s = document.createElement('script'); s.type = 'module';
    s.text = `import {drawBares,drawRosca,drawLinha,initCharts} from './charts.js';`;
    document.head.appendChild(s);
  }
  if (!__chartsOk || typeof drawBares !== 'function') return;
  initApp();
})();

function loadModule(src) {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const sc = document.createElement('script'); sc.type = 'module'; sc.src = src;
    sc.addEventListener('load', () => { resolve(); });
    sc.addEventListener('error', () => reject(new Error('Módulo de gráficos indisponível.')));
    document.head.appendChild(sc);
  });
}

// ============================= ESTADO GLOBAL ============================
const STATE = {

};

// ============================= hash + observer =============================
let OBS = null, PREV_HASH = '';
let DEBOUNCE_T = 320;

function hashStr(s) {
  try {
    const enc = encodeURIComponent(JSON.stringify(s)).slice(0, 40);
    const b = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < enc.length; i++) b.push(enc.charCodeAt(i));
    return b.reduce((a, c) => a + c, 0).toString(36) || 'a';
  } catch (e) { return '-err-'; }
}

function attachObserver() {
  if (!TARGET) return;
  OBS = new MutationObserver((mutations) => {
    if (!TARGET.isConnected || STATE.lastRender - performance.now() > DEBOUNCE_T * 10) return;
    const cur = TARGET.textContent.trim();
    try { const st = JSON.parse(cur); } catch (e) { return; }
    const h = typeof cur !== 'string' || cur.length === 0 ? '' : hashStr(cur);
    if (h !== PREV_HASH && cur.length) { PREV_HASH = h; drawAll(getState()); }
  });
  OBS.observe(TARGET, { childList: true, attributes: false, subtree: false });
}

// ============================= desenhos (leem o estado salvo em JSON) ========
function getState() {
  const raw = (TARGET?.textContent || '').trim();
  try { return JSON.parse(raw) || {}; } catch (e) { return {}; }
}

function fmtBR(v) {
  if (isNaN(v)) return '—';
  const s = v.toLocaleString('pt-BR', { signDisplay: 'plusMinus', maximumFractionDigits: 0 });
  return s.replace(/^\+/, '').replace(/\.$/, '');
}
function fmtBR2(v) {
  if (isNaN(v)) return '—';
  const s = v.toLocaleString('pt-BR', { signDisplay: 'plusMinus', maximumFractionDigits: 2 });
  return s.replace(/^\+/, '').replace(/\.$/, '');
}

function drawAll(state) {

  renderTable(state);
}

function fmtDtBr(d) {

function fmtCat(tipo) {

}
function rowHtml(r) {

    </td>
  </tr>`;
}
function esc(s) {
  return String(s ?? '').replace(/[&<>"']/g, c => ({'&':'&','<':'<','>':'>','"':'"',"'":'''}[c] || c));
}

function renderTable(state) {
  const body = document.getElementById('f-table-body');
  const wrap = document.getElementById('f-table-wrap');
  const { filters: f } = STATE;
  let data = [...(state.all_rows || [])];

  // ordenação local
  if (f.sort) {
    data = [...data].sort((a, b) => {
      const ca = getVal(a, f.sort), cb = getVal(b, f.sort);
      let cmp = (typeof ca === 'number' && typeof cb === 'number') ? ca - cb : String(ca || '').localeCompare(String(cb || ''));
      const s = f.dir === 'asc' ? 1 : -1;
      return cmp * s;
    });
  }

  const per = STATE.perPage;
  const start = (STATE.page - 1) * per;
  const pageData = data.slice(start, start + per);
  const total = data.length;
  const totalPages = per ? Math.ceil(total / per) : 1;
  const countEl = document.getElementById('f-count');

  // mensagem vazia
  const emptyMsg = document.getElementById('msg-empty-table');
  if (!pageData.length && !total) {
    emptyMsg.style.display = '';
    emptyMsg.textContent = state.empty_msg || 'Nenhum lançamento registrado.';
  } else {
    emptyMsg && emptyMsg.remove();
  }

  if (pageData.length) {
    body.innerHTML = pageData.map(rowHtml).join('');
  } else if (total) {
    // todos filtrados
    body.innerHTML = `<tr><td colspan="8" style="text-align:center;padding:2rem;color:var(--c-muted)">Nenhum resultado para os filtros atuais.</td></tr>`;
  }

  // indicações de ordenação nas cabeças
  document.querySelectorAll('.table-head').forEach(th => {
    th.removeAttribute('aria-sort');
    const c = th.dataset.sort;
    if (c === f.sort) {
      th.classList.toggle('th-asc', f.dir === 'asc');
      th.classList.toggle('th-desc', f.dir === 'desc');
      const a = th.querySelector('.th-arrow');
      if (a) a.textContent = f.dir === 'asc' ? '▲' : '▼';
      th.setAttribute('aria-sort', f.dir === 'asc' ? 'ascending' : 'descending');
    }
  });

  // recupera valores originais para validação de edição (a partir do estado real)
  data.forEach(r => { r._orig = { id: String(r.id), cat: r.cat, sub: r.sub, desc: r.desc, val: r.val, fp: r.fp, cc: r.cc }; });

  renderPagination(totalPages = totalPages);
  if (countEl) countEl.textContent = `${total} lançamentos`;
}

const LABEL_COL = {
  cat: 'Categoria', sub: 'Subcategoria', desc: 'Descrição',
  val: 'Valor (R$)', fp: 'Forma de pagamento', cc: 'Centro de custo'
};
function getVal(r, col) {
  if (col === 'id') return String(r.id);
  if (col === 'dt') return r.dt || '';
  if (col === 'val') {
    const v = r[col];
    if (typeof v === 'number') return String(v);
    try { return String(parseFloat(v.replace(/[\s,/]+/g, ''))); } catch (_) { return ''; }
  }
  return (r[col] || '').toString();
}
function getOrigVal(r, col) {
  return (r._orig && r._orig[col]) || '';
}

// --- edição de célula ---
function startEdit(td, col) {
  if (td.dataset.editing) {
    // já está editando esta célula → troca o foco
    const inp = td.querySelector('.cell-input');
    if (inp) { inp.focus(); inp.select(); return; }
    deactivateEdit(td, col);
    restoreCell(td, col);
    return;
  }
  const editableCols = ['cat', 'sub', 'desc', 'val', 'fp', 'cc'];
  if (!editableCols.includes(col)) return;
  const r = STATE.all_rows.find(x => String(x.id) === String(td.dataset.id));
  if (!r) return;
  const snap = td.outerHTML;                       // snapshot SEM o container de edição
  const container = document.createElement('div');
  container.className = 'editor-container';
  const field = col === 'cat'
    ? buildCatSelect(td, r.cat)
    : document.createElement('input');

  field.className = 'cell-input';
  field.dataset.col = col;
  if (col === 'val') { field.type = 'number'; field.step = 'any'; field.min = '-999999'; field.max = '999999'; }
  field.placeholder = LABEL_COL[col] || col;
  if (col === 'cat') {
    ['Alimentação','Moradia','Transporte','Saúde','Educação','Lazer','Investimentos','Cartão/Crédito','Trabalho','Outros']
      .forEach(c => {
        const o = document.createElement('option'); o.value = c; o.textContent = c;
        if (c === 'Outros' && !field.querySelector('option[value="Outros"]')) field.appendChild(o);
      });
    field.value = r[col] || (col === 'cat' ? 'Outros' : '');
  }
  container.appendChild(field);

  // mantém o restante do conteúdo da célula
  [...td.children].forEach(c => {
    if (c === container.firstChild || c === field) return;
    td.appendChild(c);
  });
  container.parentNode.insertBefore(container, td.firstChild);
  td.dataset.editing = '1';
  setActiveEdit(container, col, r.id, snap);

  // bindings
  setupInputBindings(field, r, col);
}

function setActiveEdit(container, col, rId, snap) {
  // local: só um edit ativo por vez
  window.__edit = { el: container, col, rId, snap };
}
function deactivateEdit(td, col) {
  const ed = window.__edit;
  if (!ed) return;
  if (ed.el && ed.el.parentElement === td) {
    [...td.children].forEach(c => {
      if (c.classList.contains('editor-container')) c.remove();
    });
    td.innerHTML = ed.snap;                          // restaura o texto original
    td.removeAttribute('data-editing');
    ed.el = null;
  }
  window.__edit = null;
}
function restoreCell(td, col) {
  const r = STATE.all_rows.find(x => String(x.id) === String(td.dataset.id));
  if (!r) return;
  const orig = getOrigVal(r, col);
  const inp = td.querySelector('.cell-input');
  if (inp) inp.value = orig;
  else td.querySelector(':scope div.cell-editor') ? nothing() : '';
}

function setupInputBindings(inp, r, col) {
  const ORIG = getOrigVal(r, col);
  const VALIDATORS = {
    val: (v) => { const pv = parseFloat(v.replace(/[\s,/]+/g, '')); return !isNaN(pv) && pv >= -1e6 && pv <= 1e6; },
    dt:   (v) => /^\d{2}\/\d{2}\/\d{4}$/.test(v),
    cat:  () => true, sub: () => true, desc: () => true, fp: () => true, cc: () => true
  };
  const onValid = () => {
    const v = inp.value;
    if (col === 'val') {
      if (!VALIDATORS.val(v)) { failValidate(inp, ORIG); return; }
      const num = parseFloat(v.replace(/[\s,/]+/g, ''));
      if (num < -1e6 || num > 1e6) { failValidate(inp, ORIG); return; }
      const rr = STATE.all_rows.find(x => String(x.id) === String(td.dataset.id));
      if (rr) rr[col] = col === 'val' ? num : String(v);
      STATE.all_rows = STATE.all_rows.map(x => x.id === rr.id ? { ...x, [col]: col === 'val' ? num : v } : x);
      deactivateEdit(td, col);
      fireSyncIfNeeded();
    } else {
      if (VALIDATORS[col](v)) {
        const rr = STATE.all_rows.find(x => String(x.id) === String(td.dataset.id));
        if (rr) rr[col] = v;
        STATE.all_rows = STATE.all_rows.map(x => x.id === rr.id ? { ...x, [col]: v } : x);
        deactivateEdit(td, col);
        fireSyncIfNeeded();
      } else {
        failValidate(inp, ORIG);
      }
    }
    inp.removeAttribute('invalid');
  };
  const failValidate = (inp, orig) => {
    inp.classList.add('invalid');
    inp.value = orig;
    const err = document.createElement('span');
    err.style.cssText = 'position:absolute;top:-1.1em;left:0;width:100%;font-size:.7rem;color:#fca5a5';
    err.textContent = col === 'val' ? 'Valor inválido — use formato R$ 1.234,56' : 'Formato inválido';
    inp.parentElement.insertBefore(err, inp);
    setTimeout(() => err.remove(), 1400);
  };
  inp.addEventListener('blur', onValid);
  inp.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
    if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') { e.preventDefault(); onValid(); }
    if (e.key === 'Escape') {
      e.stopPropagation(); deactivateEdit(td, col); restoreCell(td, col);
    }
  });
}

function buildCatSelect(td, curVal) {
  const sel = document.createElement('select'); sel.className = 'cat-select';
  ['Alimentação','Moradia','Transporte','Saúde','Educação','Lazer','Investimentos','Cartão/Crédito','Trabalho','Outros']
    .forEach(c => {
      const o = document.createElement('option'); o.value = c; o.textContent = c;
      if (c === 'Outros' && !sel.querySelector('option[value="Outros"]')) sel.appendChild(o);
    });
  sel.value = curVal || 'Outros';
  td.insertBefore(sel, td.firstChild);
  return sel;
}

async function confirmDelete(id) {
  const ok = await new Promise((resolve) => {
    const modal = document.createElement('div');
    modal.id = 'confirm-modal';
    const card = document.createElement('div');
    card.style.cssText = `background:var(--c-surface);border:1px solid var(--c-border);border-radius:16px;padding:1.2rem 1.6rem;width:min(420px,90vw);text-align:center`;
    const p = document.createElement('p'); p.textContent = 'Tem certeza de que deseja excluir este lançamento permanentemente?';
    const y = document.createElement('button'); y.className = 'yes'; y.textContent = 'Excluir';
    const n = document.createElement('button'); n.className = 'no'; n.textContent = 'Cancelar';
    card.appendChild(p); card.appendChild(y); card.appendChild(n);
    modal.appendChild(card);
    document.body.appendChild(modal);
    y.addEventListener('click', () => { modal.remove(); resolve(true); });
    n.addEventListener('click', () => { modal.remove(); resolve(false); });
    setTimeout(() => { if (!y.disabled) y.focus(); }, 50);
    // fecha se clicar fora do card
    modal.addEventListener('click', e => { if (e.target === modal) resolve(false); });
  });
}

async function fcDeleteRow(btn) {
  const id = Number(btn.dataset.id);
  if (!Number.isFinite(id)) { showMsg('er', 'ID inválido.'); return; }
  const r = STATE.all_rows.find(x => String(x.id) === String(id));
  if (r) { r._deleted = true; }
  await confirmDelete(id);
  if (confirmCancelled) return;
  try {
    const res = await fetch('/api/sync', {
      method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify({ op: 'delete', ids: [String(id)] })
    });
    if (res.ok) {
      const j = await res.json();
      removeRowFromHTML(String(id));
      showMsg('er', j.ok ? 'Lançamento excluído.' : 'Falha ao excluir.');
      fireSync();
    } else {
      showMsg('er', 'Não foi possível excluir agora. Tente novamente.');
    }
  } catch (e) {
    showMsg('er', 'Erro de conexão: ' + e.message);
  }
}
let confirmCancelled = false;

function removeRowFromHTML(id) {
  const tr = document.querySelector(`tr[data-id="${id}"]`);
  if (!tr) return;
  tr.remove();
  const rows = document.querySelectorAll('tr[data-id]');
  const total = STATE.all_rows.filter(r => !r._deleted).length;
  const per = STATE.perPage;
  const totalPages = per ? Math.ceil(total / per) : 1;
  const newPage = Math.min(STATE.page, totalPages || 1);
  STATE.page = newPage;
  fetchFilters();
}

// -------- filtros --------
const DEBP = 150;
function debounce(fn, delay) {
  let t;
  return (...a) => { clearTimeout(t); t = setTimeout(() => fn(...a), delay); };
}
const debSearch = debounce(fetchFilters, DEBP);

async function fetchFilters(opts = {}) {
  if (document.readyState !== 'loading' && document.readyState !== 'complete') return;
  const cur = new URL(location.href);
  const params = new URLSearchParams(cur.search || '');
  // preserva params existentes (exceto page)
  for (const [k, v] of params.entries()) {
    if (opts[k] !== undefined) params.set(k, String(opts[k]));
    else if (k !== 'page') params.set(k, v);
  }
  // aplica obrigatórios
  if (opts.q   !== undefined) params.set('q', String(opts.q));
  if (opts.tipo !== undefined) params.set('tipo', String(opts.tipo));
  if (opts.inicio !== undefined) params.set('inicio', String(opts.inicio));
  if (opts.fim !== undefined) params.set('fim', String(opts.fim));
  if (opts.status !== undefined) params.set('status', String(opts.status));
  if (opts.sort !== undefined) params.set('sort', String(opts.sort));
  if (opts.dir !== undefined) params.set('dir', String(opts.dir));
  const page = opts.page || STATE.page;
  params.set('page', String(page));

  const qs = params.toString();
  const urlStr = (cur.pathname.endsWith('/') ? cur.pathname : cur.pathname) + (qs ? '?' + qs : '');
  try {
    const res = await fetch(urlStr, { credentials: 'omit', headers: { Accept: 'application/json' } });
    if (!res.ok) { showMsg('er', res.statusText || 'Falha ao carregar a lista.'); return; }
    const d = await res.json();
    if (d.error) { showMsg('er', d.error); return; }

    // atualiza estado para o cliente reagir
    STATE.filters = {
      q: d.q || STATE.filters.q,
      tipo: d.tipo || STATE.filters.tipo,
      inicio: d.inicio || STATE.filters.inicio,
      fim: d.fim || STATE.filters.fim,
      status: d.status || STATE.filters.status
    };
    if (d.sort) { STATE.filters.sort = d.sort; STATE.filters.dir = d.dir || 'desc'; }
    STATE.page = d.page || 1;

    updateCount(Number(d.totalCount) || 0);
    renderTable({
      all_rows: d.all_rows || [],
      page: STATE.page, perPage: STATE.perPage,
      total: Number(d.total) || 0, totalCount: Number(d.totalCount) || 0,
      empty_msg: d.empty_msg
    });

    // reconstrói seletor de datas
    buildDateSelectors();
  } catch (e) { showMsg('er', 'Erro de rede: ' + e.message); }
}

function buildDateSelectors() {
  const selI = document.getElementById('f-inicio');
  const selF = document.getElementById('f-fim');
  if (!selI || !selF) return;
  const dates = STATE.options_dates || [];
  const opts = `<option value="">-- selecione --</option>` +
    dates.map(d => `<option value="${d}">${fmtISOShort(d)}</option>`).join('');
  [selI, selF].forEach(s => { s.innerHTML = opts; s.value = '';
    s.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubble: true })); });
}
function fmtISOShort(iso) {
  try { return new Date(iso + 'T00:00:00').toLocaleDateString('pt-BR', { month: 'short', day: '2-digit' }); }
  catch (_) { return iso; }
}

function fcClearFilters() {
  STATE.filters = { q: '', tipo: '', inicio: '', fim: '', status: '' };
  STATE.sort = null; STATE.dir = 'desc';
  fetchFilters({
    q: '', tipo: '', inicio: '', fim: '', status: '', page: 1
  });
}

function fcGoPage(n) {
  if (n < 1 || n > Math.ceil((Number(document.getElementById('f-count')?.textContent || 0) / STATE.perPage) || 1)) return;
  STATE.page = n;
  fetchFilters({ page: n });
}

// -------- navegação entre abas --------
function switchTab(tabId) {
  const tab = Array.from(TABSTRIP).find(b => b.getAttribute('data-tab') === tabId);
  if (!tab) return;
  TABSTRIP.forEach(bt => bt.removeAttribute('data-on'); bt.classList.remove('active'));
  tab.setAttribute('data-on', 'active'); tab.classList.add('active');
  TABSTRIP[0]?.setAttribute('aria-selected', 'false');
  tab.setAttribute('aria-selected', 'true');
  SECTIONS.forEach(s => s.classList.remove('active'));
  const sec = document.getElementById('view-' + tabId);
  if (sec) sec.classList.add('active');
  document.querySelectorAll('.announcement').forEach(a => a.classList.remove('active'));
  localStorage.setItem('fc-tab', tabId);

  if (tabId === 'lançamentos') {
    fetchFilters({ page: STATE.page });
    announce('A visualização de lançamentos foi ativada.');
  }
}

// -------- painel de sincronização --------
let SYNC_TIMER = null;
let LAST_HASH = null;

function fireSync(force = false) {
  if (STATE.syncing) return;
  STATE.syncing = true;
  syncNow().finally(() => { STATE.syncing = false; });
}

async function syncNow() {
  if (!STATE.autoSync && !document.getElementById('btn-sync').classList.contains('syncing')) return;
  const state = getState();
  const h = hashStr(state);
  if (LAST_HASH === h) return;              // nada mudou
  LAST_HASH = h;
  try {
    const res = await fetch('/api/sync', {
      method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify({ op: 'update', rows: state.all_rows })
    });
    if (!res.ok) throw new Error(res.statusText);
    const j = await res.json();
    if (j.ok) {
      STATE.lastSyncTs = j Ultima sincronizacao || new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);
      updateSyncChip(STATE.lastSyncTs);
      showSuccess('Sincronizado com sucesso!');
      SYNC_TIMER = null;                      // pausa o timer automático
    } else {
      showMsg('er', j.error || 'Falha ao sincronizar.');
    }
  } catch (e) {
    // retenta em ~2s com atraso
    setTimeout(syncNow, 2200 + Math.random() * 800);
    showInfo('Retentendo sincronização…');
  }
}

function startAutoSync(interval = 2500) {
  if (SYNC_TIMER) clearInterval(SYNC_TIMER);
  SYNC_TIMER = setInterval(() => {
    if (!STATE.autoSync) return;
    if (LAST_HASH !== hashStr(getState())) syncNow();
  }, interval);
}
function stopAutoSync() {
  if (SYNC_TIMER) { clearInterval(SYNC_TIMER); SYNC_TIMER = null; }
}

document.getElementById('btn-sync').addEventListener('click', () => {
  fireSync(true);
  const btn = document.getElementById('btn-sync');
  btn.disabled = false;
  btn.classList.remove('syncing');
  btn.innerHTML = '<span>💾 Salvar agora</span>';
});

let AUTO_FLAG = localStorage.getItem('fc-auto-sync') === '1';
function toggleAutoSync() {
  const next = !AUTO_FLAG;
  STATE.autoSync = next;
  localStorage.setItem('fc-auto-sync', next ? '1' : '0');
  const btn = document.getElementById('btn-sync');
  btn.classList.toggle('syncing', next);
  btn.disabled = !next;
  btn.innerHTML = next ? '<span>⏳ Automático ativo (2,5 s)</span>' : '<span>⏹ Automático desligado</span>';
  const chip = document.getElementById('sync-status');
  if (!AUTO_FLAG && next) startAutoSync();

let lastPollTs = null;
function updateSyncChip(ts) {
  const chip = document.getElementById('sync-status');
  if (!ts || !chip) { chip.classList.add('hidden'); return; }
  const now = Date.now();
  const diff = now - new Date(ts).getTime();
  const m = Math.round((now - new Date(ts).getTime()) / 60000);
  let rel = m < 60 ? `há ${m} s` : `${Math.round(m / 60)} min`;
  if (!rel) rel = 'há pouco';
  chip.classList.remove('hidden');
  chip.querySelector('.dot').style.background = 'var(--c-green)';
  chip.innerHTML = `<span class="dot"></span> ✓ sincronizado ${rel}`;
}

// -------- mensagens / toasts --------
const MAX_BANNERS = 3;
function showMsg(type, text, dur = 4200) {
  if (BANNER.childElementCount > MAX_BANNERS) {
    [...BANNER.children].slice(MAX_BANNERS - (MAX_BANNERS - BANNER.childElementCount + 1)).forEach(n => n.remove());
  }
  BANNER.innerHTML = '';
  const item = document.createElement('div');
  item.className = `msg-item msg--${type}`;
  item.textContent = text;
  BANNER.appendChild(item);
  requestAnimationFrame(() => {
    item.style.transition = 'opacity .2s, transform .2s';
    setTimeout(() => item.classList.add('entered'), 60);
  });
  setTimeout(() => {
    item.classList.remove('entered');
    setTimeout(() => { if (item.parentElement.childElementCount <= MAX_BANNERS) item.remove(); }, dur);
  }, dur);
}

const TOAST_TYPES = { su: 'toast--success', er: 'toast--error', in: 'toast--info' };
function showToast(msg, type = 'su') {
  const cls = TOAST_TYPES[type];
  const el = document.createElement('div');
  el.className = `toast toast--${cls}`;
  el.textContent = msg;
  if (!TOASTBOX.childElementCount) TOASTBOX.appendChild(el);
  else const prev = TOASTBOX.firstChild; if (prev && prev.classList.contains('toast')) prev.remove();
  TOASTBOX.prepend(el);
  requestAnimationFrame(() => {
    el.style.transition = 'opacity .2s, transform .2s';
    setTimeout(() => el.classList.add('show'), 80);
  });
  setTimeout(() => { el.classList.remove('show'); setTimeout(() => el.remove(), 260); }, 4000);
}

// -------- inicialização ----------
async function initApp() {
  attachObserver();

  // dados iniciais embutidos no HTML + busca completa em /api/data se faltarem
  const raw = (TARGET?.textContent || '').trim();
  if (raw) {
    STATE = JSON.parse(raw);
  } else {
    try {
      const res = await fetch('/api/data', { credentials: 'omit' });
      const data = await res.json();
      STATE.linhas = data.map(r => ({
        id: r.id, cat: r.cat, sub: r.sub, desc: r.desc, val: r.val,
        fp: r.fp, cc: r.cc, st: r.st, dt: r.dt, kind: r.val >= 0 ? 'receita' : 'despesa'
      }));
      STATE.options_dates = data.map(r => r.dt);
    } catch (e) {
      showMsg('er', 'Não foi possível carregar a base. Tente novamente.');
      return;
    }
  }

  // se a lista veio do HTML (existe), mantém; senão complementa via fetch
  if (!STATE.linhas || STATE.linhas.length === 0) {
    try {
      const res = await fetch('/api/data', { credentials: 'omit' });
      const data = await res.json();
      STATE.linhas = data.map(r => ({
        id: r.id, cat: r.cat, sub: r.sub, desc: r.desc, val: r.val,
        fp: r.fp, cc: r.cc, st: r.st, dt: r.dt, kind: r.val >= 0 ? 'receita' : 'despesa'
      }));
      STATE.options_dates = data.map(r => r.dt);
    } catch (e) {
      showMsg('er', 'Base indisponível.');
      return;
    }
  }

  const dates = new Set(STATE.options_dates);
  buildDateSelectors();
  setTarget(STATE);
  drawAll(STATE);

  // tabs: restaura preferência em localStorage
  const tab = localStorage.getItem('fc-tab');
  if (tab) switchTab(tab);
  else switchTab('dashboard');

  startAutoSync(2500);
  updateSyncUI();
  bindToolbar();
}

function bindToolbar() {
  const importSec = document.getElementById('view-importar');
  if (!importSec) return;
  const drop = document.getElementById('import-drop');
  const fileIn = document.getElementById('import-file');
  const list = document.getElementById('import-list');
  const preview = document.getElementById('import-preview');
  const btn = document.getElementById('import-btn');

  drop.addEventListener('click', e => { if (e.target === drop || e.target.closest('.hidden')) fileIn.click(); });
  drop.addEventListener('dragover', e => { e.preventDefault(); drop.classList.add('dr'); });
  drop.addEventListener('dragleave', () => drop.classList.remove('dr'));
  drop.addEventListener('drop', e => { e.preventDefault(); processFiles(e.dataTransfer?.files || []); });
  fileIn.addEventListener('change', e => processFiles([...fileIn.files]));

  btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
    if (!fileIn.files.length) { showMsg('er', 'Selecione ou arraste um CSV válido primeiro.'); return; }
    setStatus('Enviando arquivo…');
    const fr = fileIn.files[0];
    const fd = new FormData(); fd.append('arquivo', fr);
    fetch('/import', { method: 'POST', body: fd })
      .then(r => { if (!r.ok) throw new Error(r.statusText); return r.json(); })
      .then(j => {
        let msg = '✅ Importação concluída!';
        if (j.substituidos) msg += ` Substituídos ${j.substituidos}.`;
        if (j.inseridos) msg += ` Inseridos ${j.inseridos}.`;
        showToast(msg, 'su');
      })
      .catch(e => showToast('Falha ao enviar: ' + e.message || 'Erro de rede.', 'er'))
      .finally(() => setTimeout(() => location.href = '/?tab=lançamentos', 900));
  });

  function processFiles(files) {
    drop.classList.remove('dr');
    list.innerHTML = '';
    const msgBox = document.getElementById('msg-import');
    msgBox?.remove();
    let previewParts = [];
    files.forEach(f => {
      const li = document.createElement('li');
      li.className = 'file-item';
      const name = document.createElement('span');
      name.className = 'fn'; name.textContent = f.name; li.appendChild(name);
      const reader = new FileReader();
      reader.onload = ev => {
        try {
          const txt = ev.target.result.toString('utf-8');
          const lines = txt.split('\n').filter(Boolean).slice(0, 6).map(l => l.trim());
          const joined = lines.join(' · ');
          if (previewParts.length) previewParts.push('---');
          previewParts.push(`"${f.name}"\n${joined || '(vazio/nulo)'}`);
        } catch (_) {}
      };
      reader.read(f, 'utf-8');
      li.appendChild(document.createElement('br'));
      list.appendChild(li);
    });
    document.getElementById('preview-txt')?.remove();
    const pb = document.getElementById('import-preview') || document.createElement('div');
    pb.id = 'import-preview'; pb.className = 'preview-box';
    pb.textContent = previewParts.join('\n\n');
    if (files.length) {
      btn.disabled = false;
      btn.classList.remove('loading');
      // valida cabeçalho do 1º arquivo
      const first = files[0].size ? (new FileReader()).read(files[0]) : '';
      // (validação feita no servidor; aviso simples aqui)
    }
  }

  // drag & drop validation visual
  drop.addEventListener('drop', e => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!e.dataTransfer?.files) return;
    const txt = new FileReader().read(e.dataTransfer.files[0], 'utf-8');
    const firstLine = txt.split('\n')[0].trim();
    if (/^id,\s*$/.test(firstLine)) {
      const chk = document.createElement('span');
      chk.style.cssText = 'color:var(--c-green-eb);font-size:.75rem;margin-top:.3rem';
      chk.textContent = 'Formato correto ✓ (coluna "id" identificada)';
      drop.appendChild(chk);
    } else {
      drop.innerHTML = `<div style="color:#fca5a5;font-size:.8rem">⚠ O primeiro campo deve ser "id"</div>`;
    }
  });
}

// (injeta no HTML via script embutido; usado por drawAll)
// Aqui apenas garantimos que o objeto STATE seja serializável sem datas soltas:
function sanitizeState() {
  const s = { ...STATE };
  if (s.linhas) s.linhas = s.linhas.map(r => ({
    id: r.id, cat: r.cat, sub: r.sub, desc: r.desc,
    val: Number(r.val) || 0, fp: r.fp, cc: r.cc,
    st: r.st || 'ativo', kind: (r.val || 0) >= 0 ? 'receita' : 'despesa',
    dt: fmtDtBr(r.dt)
  }));
  s.kpis = (s.kpis || []).map(k => ({ ...k, value: typeof k.value === 'object' ? '' : k.value }));
  return s;
}

O arquivo definitivo fica em: caixa_dashboard/data/caixa.csv

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------- LCG
def _lcg() -> float:
    """Sequência pseudo-aleatória determinística (sem dependência de numpy)."""
    a, c, m = 1664525, 1013904222, 2 ** 31
    t = (m * 42 + c) % m
    t = (a * t + c) % m
    return t / (m - 1)


def _rand_u() -> float:
    return _lcg()


def _rand_int(lo: int, hi: int) -> int:
    t = _lcg()
    return int(((t * 908810638 + 717980991) % (2 ** 31)) / (2 ** 31)
                * (hi - lo + 1) + lo)


# ----------------------------------------------------------------- conversores
def _safe_dt(s: str) -> Optional[date]:
    """Converte strings comuns em date; retorna None se não for parseável."""
    s = str(s).strip()
    m = re.match(r"^(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2})$", s)
    if m:
        try: return date(int(m.group(1)), int(m.group(2)), int(m.group(3)))
        except Exception: pass
    m = re.match(r"^(\d{2})[\/](\d{2})[\/](\d{4})$", s)
    if m:
        try:
            d, mm, y = int(m.group(1)), int(m.group(2)), int(m.group(3))
            if 1 <= d <= 31 and 1 <= mm <= 12:
                return date(y, mm, d)
        except Exception: pass
    m = re.match(r"^(\d{2})[\/](\d{2})[\/](\d{2})$", s)
    if m:
        try:
            a, b, c = int(m.group(1)), int(m.group(2)), int(m.group(3))
            if 1 <= a <= 12 and 1 <= b <= 12:          # formato aa.mm.dd (Brasil)
                cent = 2000 if a <= 59 else 1900
                return date(cent + c, b, a)
        except Exception: pass
    return None


def _fmt_moeda(v: float) -> str:
    """R$ 1.234,56 | R$ -123,45  (precisão via Decimal, independente do float binário)."""
    dv = Decimal(str(v)).quantize(Decimal("0.01"), rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP)
    neg = str(dv) < 0
    dv = abs(dv)
    inteiro = int(dv)
    fracao = (dv - Decimal(inteiro)) * 100
    fracao = f"{float(fracao):.2f}".rstrip("0").rstrip(".").lstrip("0") or "00"
    int_s = f"{inteiro:,}".replace(",", ".")
    return ("-" if neg else "") + "R$" + int_s + "," + fracao


def _try_num_br(s: str) -> float:
    """Aceita 1.234,56 / -123,45 / 1,2 / 123456 (remove R$, espaços etc.)."""
    s = str(s).strip().lstrip("(").rstrip(")").lstrip("-+")
    if not s:
        return 0.0
    s = re.sub(r"[^\d.,\-]", "", s)                       # remove R$, símbolos
    if "," in s:                                          # assume formato BR (vírgula decimal)
        i = s.rfind(",")
        try:
            return float(s[:i] + "." + s[i + 1:])
        except Exception:
            j = s.rfind(".")
            if j > i:
                return float(s[:j] + s[j + 1:])
            return float(s.replace(",", "."))
    try:
        return float(s)
    except Exception:
        return 0.0


def _id_norm(v: Any) -> str:
    """Identificador único: int positivo (ou UUID se não parsear)."""
    v = str(v).strip()
    if not v:
        return str(uuid.uuid4())
    try:
        n = int(float(v).replace(".", "").replace(",", "").replace("-", "").replace("+", ""))
        if n < 0:
            n = 0
        return str(n)
    except Exception:
        return str(uuid.uuid4())


def _fmt_date_iso(o: Any) -> str:
    if isinstance(o, date):
        return o.isoformat()
    if isinstance(o, str):
        m = _safe_dt(o)
        if m:
            return m.isoformat()
        # tentativa de recuperar ano de formato aa.mm.dd
        mt = re.match(r"^(\d{2})[\/](\d{2})[\/](\d{4})$", o)
        if mt:
            try:
                d, mm, y = int(mt.group(1)), int(mt.group(2)), int(mt.group(3))
                if 1 <= d <= 31 and 1 <= mm <= 12:
                    return f"{y}-{mm:02d}-{d:02d}"
            except Exception:
                pass
        mt2 = re.match(r"^(\d{2})[\/](\d{2})[\/](\d{2})$", o)
        if mt2:
            try:
                a, b, c = int(mt2.group(1)), int(mt2.group(2)), int(mt2.group(3))
                if 1 <= a <= 12 and 1 <= b <= 12:
                    cent = 2000 if a <= 59 else 1900
                    return f"{cent+c}-{b:02d}-{a:02d}"
            except Exception:
                pass
        return ""
    return ""


def _key_date(r: Dict[str, Any]) -> tuple:
    """Ordenação: (data ou sentinel futuro, -id numérico)."""
    d = r.get("data")
    b = d if isinstance(d, date) else (date(9999, 12, 31), None)[1]   # sentinel final para nulos
    n = 0
    try:
        n = int(r.get("id", ""))
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        pass
    return (not isinstance(b[0], date), b[0], -n if n >= 0 else -999)


def _sort_key(r: Dict[str, Any]) -> tuple:
    d = r.get("data")
    b = d if isinstance(d, date) else date(9999, 12, 31)
    n = 0
    try:
        n = int(r.get("id", ""))
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        pass
    return (not isinstance(b, date), b, -n if n >= 0 else -999)

        self.rows: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
        self.unique: set = set()
        self.idx: Dict[str, int] = {}

    def _load(self):

            return

            self._saved()
            self._loaded = True
            return
        try:
            self.rows, self.idx = self._from_csv()
        except Exception as e:
            logger.warning("CSV aparentemente corrompido (%s) — mantendo base vazia.", e)

    @staticmethod
    def _from_csv() -> tuple:
        rows, idx = [], {}
        seen = set()
        with self.path.open(encoding="utf-8-sig", newline="", errors="replace") as fh:
            raw = list(csv.reader(fh, delimiter=","))
        if not raw:
            return [], {}
        norm = [h.strip() for h in (raw[0] or [])]
        expected = [c.strip().lower() for c in COLS]
        if sorted(norm) != sorted(expected):
            raise ValueError(
                f"Cabeçalho incompatível.\nEsperado: {', '.join(COLS)}\n"
                f"Encontrado:  {', '.join(norm)}"
            )
        for i, row in enumerate(raw[1:], start=1):
            arr = list(row)
            rec = {}
            for j, col in enumerate(COLS):
                rawv = arr[j].strip() if j < len(arr) else ""
                if col == "id":
                    rawv = _id_norm(rawv)
                elif col == "valor":
                    rawv = _try_num_br(rawv)
                elif col == "data":
                    rawv = _safe_dt(rawv) or date(1970, 1, 1)
                elif col == "status":
                    rawv = rawv if rawv in ("ativo", "inativo") else "ativo"
                rec[col] = rawv
            while len(rec) < len(COLS):
                rec[list(rec.keys())[-1]] = ""      # completa campos faltantes
            cid = rec["id"]
            if cid in seen and cid in idx:
                # substitui a ocorrência mais antiga (deduplicação inteligente)
                oi = idx[cid]
                dup = dict(self.rows[oi])
                rec.update(dup)
                rec["valor"] = _try_num_br(rec["valor"])
                rec["data"] = _safe_dt(rec["data"]) or date(1970, 1, 1)
                self.rows[oi] = rec
                idx[cid] = len(self.rows) - 1
                seen.add(cid)
                continue
            self.rows.append(rec)
            seen.add(cid)
            idx[cid] = len(self.rows) - 1
        self.rows.sort(key=_sort_key)
        return self.rows, idx

    def _touch_empty(self):
        """Escreve CSV vazio com cabeçalho, para leitura rápida futura (sem perder nada)."""
        if not self.path.exists():
            return
        with self.path.open("w", encoding="utf-8", newline="") as fh:
            writer = csv.writer(fh, delimiter=",", lineterminator="\r\n")
            writer.writerow(COLS)

    def _saved(self):
        """Reescreve o CSV na íntegra (ordenado) com formatação pt‑BR.””"""
        if not self.rows:
            self._touch_empty()
            return
        tmp = str(self.path.with_suffix(".tmp_write"))
        try:
            with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(mode="w", suffix=".csv", delete=False,
                                             encoding="utf-8", newline="", dir=self.path.parent,
                                             prefix="_fc_dump_") as tmpf:
                wr = csv.writer(tmpf, delimiter=",", quoting=csv.QUOTE_MINIMAL,
                                lineterminator="\r\n")
                wr.writerow(COLS)
                for r in self._sorted():
                    out = []
                    for col in COLS:
                        v = r.get(col)
                        if col == "valor":
                            out.append(_fmt_moeda(float(v)))
                        elif col == "data":
                            vs = _fmt_date_iso(v)
                            out.append(vs if vs else "")
                            continue
                        out.append("" if v in (None, "") else str(v))
                    wr.writerow(out)
                tmpf.close()
            os.replace(tmp, str(self.path))
        except OSError:
            try:
                os.unlink(tmp)
            except FileNotFoundError:
                pass
        self._loaded = True

    def _sorted(self) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
        return sorted(self.rows, key=_sort_key)

    def add(self, r: Dict[str, Any]) -> None:
        cid = r["id"]
        if cid in self.idx:
            oi = self.idx[cid]
            for k in COLS:
                if k != "id" and k in r:
                    r[k] = self.rows[oi].get(k, "")
                if k == "valor":
                    r["valor"] = _try_num_br(r["valor"])
                if k == "data":
                    r["data"] = _safe_dt(r["data"]) or date(1970, 1, 1)
            self.rows[oi] = r
            self.idx[cid] = len(self.rows) - 1
            return
        self.rows.append(r)
        self.unique.add(cid)
        self.idx[cid] = len(self.rows) - 1

    def remove_by_id(self, cid: str) -> bool:
        if cid not in self.idx:
            return False
        pos = self.idx.pop(cid)
        del self.rows[pos]
        for k in list(self.idx.keys()):
            if self.idx[k] > pos:
                self.idx[k] -= 1
        self.unique = {v for v in self.idx.values()}
        return True

    def stats(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:

        saidas = -sum(_v(r, "valor") for r in ativa if _v(r, "valor") < 0)

                    "melhor_mes": (None, None), "pior_mes": (None, None),
                    "maior_receita": (None, None), "maior_despesa": (None, None)}

        first, last = min(datas), max(datas)
        span_sec = (last - first).total_seconds()
        span_days = max(span_sec / 86400 or 1, 1)
        n_dias = len({r["data"] for r in ativa if isinstance(r.get("data"), date)})
        media = total / n_dias if n_dias else 0.0

        def _mes(r) -> Optional[str]:
            d = r.get("data")
            return d.strftime("%Y-%m") if isinstance(d, date) else None

            if v > 0:
                m["rec"] += v
            elif v < 0:
                m["desp"] += abs(v)

        melhor = pior = None
        for k, v in ranked:
            cur = v[1]["rec"] - v[1]["desp"]
            if melhor is None or cur > (melhor[1]["rec"] - melhor[1]["desp"]):
                melhor = (k, cur)
            if pior is None or cur < (pior[1]["rec"] - pior[1]["desp"]):

        said = [r for r in ativa if _v(r, "valor") < 0]

                return (None, None)
            best = max(lista, key=fun)
            return (best, fun(best))
        maior_rec, maior_rec_v = _top(entr, lambda r: _v(r, "valor"))
        maior_desp, maior_desp_v = _top(said, lambda r: _v(r, "valor"))

        return {
            "saldo": round(total, 2),
            "entradas": round(entradas, 2),
            "saidas": round(saidas, 2),
            "movimentacoes": len(ativa),

             "cls": cls_md,

        return {"meses": [_month_entry(*([int(y.split('-')[0]), m] for y, m in

def _lcg() -> float:
    """Sequência pseudo-aleatória determinística (sem numpy)."""
    a, c, m = 1664525, 1013904222, 2 ** 31

def _fmt_moeda(v: float) -> str:
    """R$ 1.234,56  |  R$ -123,45  (Decimal para evitar imprecisão de float)."""
    dv = Decimal(str(v)).quantize(Decimal("0.01"), rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP)
    neg = str(dv) < 0
    dv = abs(dv)
    inteiro = int(dv)
    fracao = (dv - Decimal(inteiro)) * 100
    fracao = f"{float(fracao):.2f}".rstrip("0").rstrip(".").lstrip("0") or "00"
    int_s = f"{inteiro:,}".replace(",", ".")
    return ("-" if neg else "") + "R$" + int_s + "," + fracao


def _try_num_br(s: str) -> float:
    """Aceita 1.234,56 / -123,45 / 1,2 / 123456 (ignora R$, espaços, símbolos)."""
    s = str(s).strip().lstrip("(").rstrip(")").lstrip("-+")
    if not s:
        return 0.0
    s = re.sub(r"[^\d.,\-]", "", s)
    if "," in s:
        i = s.rfind(",")
        try:
            return float(s[:i] + "." + s[i + 1:])
        except Exception:
            j = s.rfind(".")
            if j > i:
                return float(s[:j] + s[j + 1:])
            return float(s.replace(",", "."))
    try:

    except Exception:

# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-

Na primeira execução, sem nenhum CSV no disco, o app gera uma base
  fictícia de ~160 lançamentos (método CaixaDB._bootsample()).

import csv
import io
import logging

import re
import shutil
import tempfile
import time
import uuid
from datetime import date, datetime, timedelta
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional
from decimal import Decimal, ROUND_HALF_UP

from fastht.ml import FastHTM
from fastht.ml.utils import render_jinja
from flask import jsonify

try:
    logging.basicConfig(level=logging.INFO,
                        format="%(asctime)s %(levelname)s %(name)s: %(message)s")
except Exception:
    pass

PROJECT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
DATA_DIR = PROJECT / "data"
STATIC_DIR = PROJECT / "static"
TEMPLATES_DIR = PROJECT / "templates"

STATIC_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
TEMPLATES_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

PORT = int(os.environ.get("FC_PORT", 8000))

COLS = ("id", "categoria", "subcategoria", "descricao", "data", "valor",
        "forma_pagamento", "centro_custo", "status")

app = FastHTM(debug=DEBUG)
app.host = "0.0.0.0" if DEBUG else "127.0.0.1"

_logger = logging.getLogger("fluxo_caixa")


# ------------------------------------------------------------------- helpers
def _lcg() -> float:
    a, c, m = 1664525, 1013904222, 2 ** 31
    t = (m * 42 + c) % m
    t = (a * t + c) % m
    return t / (m - 1)


def _rand_u() -> float:
    return _lcg()


def _rand_int(lo: int, hi: int) -> int:
    t = _lcg()
    return int(((t * 908810638 + 717980991) % (2 ** 31)) / (2 ** 31) * (hi - lo + 1) + lo)


def _fmt_moeda(v: float) -> str:
    """R$ 1.234,56  |  R$ -123,45  (com Decimal, sem imprecisão de float)."""
    dv = Decimal(str(v)).quantize(Decimal("0.01"), rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP)
    neg = str(dv) < 0
    dv = abs(dv)
    inteiro = int(dv)
    fracao = (dv - Decimal(inteiro)) * 100
    fracao = f"{float(fracao):.2f}".rstrip("0").rstrip(".").lstrip("0") or "00"
    int_s = f"{inteiro:,}".replace(",", ".")
    return ("-" if neg else "") + "R$" + int_s + "," + fracao


def _try_num_br(s: str) -> float:
    """1.234,56 / -123,45 / 1,2 / 123456 — remove R$, espaços, símbolos."""
    s = str(s).strip().lstrip("(").rstrip(")").lstrip("-+")
    if not s:
        return 0.0
    s = re.sub(r"[^\d.,\-]", "", s)
    if "," in s:
        i = s.rfind(",")
        try:
            return float(s[:i] + "." + s[i + 1:])
        except Exception:
            j = s.rfind(".")
            if j > i:
                return float(s[:j] + s[j + 1:])
            return float(s.replace(",", "."))
    try:
        return float(s)
    except Exception:
        return 0.0


def _id_norm(v: Any) -> str:
    v = str(v).strip()
    if not v:
        return str(uuid.uuid4())
    try:
        n = int(float(v).replace(".", "").replace(",", "").replace("-", "").replace("+", ""))
        if n < 0:
            n = 0
        return str(n)
    except Exception:
        return str(uuid.uuid4())


def _fmt_date_iso(o: Any) -> str:
    """ISO-8601 (2025-06-15) ou recuperação de formatos dd/mm/aaaa."""
    if isinstance(o, date):
        return o.isoformat()
    if isinstance(o, str):
        m = re.match(r"^(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2})$", o)
        if m:
            try: return date(int(m.group(1)), int(m.group(2)), int(m.group(3))).isoformat()
            except Exception: pass
        m = re.match(r"^(\d{2})[\/](\d{2})[\/](\d{4})$", o)
        if m:
            try:
                d, mm, y = int(m.group(1)), int(m.group(2)), int(m.group(3))
                if 1 <= d <= 31 and 1 <= mm <= 12:
                    return f"{y}-{mm:02d}-{d:02d}"
            except Exception: pass
        m = re.match(r"^(\d{2})[\/](\d{2})[\/](\d{2})$", o)
        if m:
            try:
                a, b, c = int(m.group(1)), int(m.group(2)), int(m.group(3))
                if 1 <= a <= 12 and 1 <= b <= 12:
                    century = 2000 if a <= 59 else 1900 + 100 * ((a // 10) % 100) + (a % 10) * 10
                    return f"{century}-{b:02d}-{a:02d}"
            except Exception: pass
        return ""
    return ""


def _key_date(r: Dict[str, Any]) -> tuple:
    """Chave de ordenação: (tem_data?, data ou fim, -id)."""
    d = r.get("data")
    b = d if isinstance(d, date) else date(9999, 12, 31)
    n = 0
    try:
        n = int(r.get("id", ""))
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        pass
    return (not isinstance(b, date), b, -n if n >= 0 else -999)


def _sort_key(r: Dict[str, Any]) -> tuple:
    d = r.get("data")
    b = d if isinstance(d, date) else date(9999, 12, 31)
    n = 0
    try:
        n = int(r.get("id", ""))
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        pass
    return (not isinstance(b, date), b, -n if n >= 0 else -999)


# ======================================================================
#  CaixaDB
# ======================================================================

class CaixaDB:
    """Banco em CSV único. Lê/grava com formatação pt-BR no valor."""

    def __init__(self, path: Path = None):
        self.path = path or (DATA_DIR / "caixa.csv")
        self.rows: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
        self.unique: set = set()
        self.idx: Dict[str, int] = {}
        self._loaded = False

    def _load(self):
        if self._loaded:
            return
        if not self.path.exists():
            self._bootsample()
            self._saved()
            self._loaded = True
            return
        try:
            self.rows, self.idx = self._from_csv()
        except Exception as e:
            _logger.warning("CSV corrompido (%s) — base vazia mantida com aviso.", e)
            self._touch_empty()
            self._loaded = True
            return
        self._loaded = True

    @staticmethod
    def _from_csv() -> tuple:
        rows, idx = [], {}
        seen = set()
        with self.path.open(encoding="utf-8-sig", newline="", errors="replace") as fh:
            raw = list(csv.reader(fh, delimiter=","))
        if not raw:
            return [], {}
        norm = [h.strip() for h in (raw[0] or [])]
        exp = [c.strip().lower() for c in COLS]
        if sorted(norm) != sorted(exp):
            raise ValueError(
                f"Cabeçalho inesperado.\nEsperado: {', '.join(COLS)}\nEncontrado: {', '.join(norm)}"
            )
        for i, row in enumerate(raw[1:], start=1):
            arr = list(row)
            rec = {}
            for j, col in enumerate(COLS):
                rawv = arr[j].strip() if j < len(arr) else ""
                if col == "id":
                    rawv = _id_norm(rawv)
                elif col == "valor":
                    rawv = _try_num_br(rawv)
                elif col == "data":
                    rawv = _safe_dt(rawv) or date(1970, 1, 1)
                elif col == "status":
                    rawv = rawv if rawv in ("ativo", "inativo") else "ativo"
                rec[col] = rawv
            while len(rec) < len(COLS):
                rec[list(rec.keys())[-1]] = ""
            cid = rec["id"]
            if cid in seen and cid in idx:
                # deduplicação: substitui a linha antiga pela nova
                oi = idx[cid]
                dup = dict(CaixaDB.rows)  # não existe como método; usamos self.rows
                dup = dict(self.rows[oi])
                for k in rec:
                    rec[k] = dup.get(k, "")
                    if k == "valor":
                        rec[k] = _try_num_br(rec[k])
                    if k == "data":
                        rec[k] = _safe_dt(rec[k]) or date(1970, 1, 1)
                self.rows[oi] = rec
                idx[cid] = len(self.rows) - 1
                seen.add(cid)
                continue
            self.rows.append(rec)
            seen.add(cid)
            idx[cid] = len(self.rows) - 1
        self.rows.sort(key=_sort_key)
        return self.rows, idx

    def _touch_empty(self):
        """Escreve um CSV vazio com cabeçalho (para não falhar leituras futuras)."""
        if not self.path.exists():
            return
        with self.path.open("w", encoding="utf-8", newline="") as fh:
            writer = csv.writer(fh, delimiter=",", lineterminator="\r\n")
            writer.writerow(COLS)

    def _saved(self):
        """Reescreve o CSV na íntegra (ordenado) com valores formatados pt-BR."""
        if not self.rows:
            self._touch_empty()
            return
        tmp = str(self.path.with_suffix(".tmp_write"))
        try:
            with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(mode="w", suffix=".csv", delete=False,
                                             encoding="utf-8", newline="", dir=self.path.parent,
                                             prefix="_fc_") as tmpf:
                wr = csv.writer(tmpf, delimiter=",", quoting=csv.QUOTE_MINIMAL, lineterminator="\r\n")
                wr.writerow(COLS)
                for r in self._sorted():
                    out = []
                    for col in COLS:
                        v = r.get(col)
                        if col == "valor":
                            out.append(_fmt_moeda(float(v)))
                        elif col == "data":
                            vs = _fmt_date_iso(v)
                            out.append(vs if vs else "")
                            continue
                        out.append("" if v in (None, "") else str(v))
                    wr.writerow(out)
                tmpf.close()
            shutil.move(tmp, str(self.path))
        except OSError:
            try:
                os.unlink(tmp)
            except FileNotFoundError:
                pass
        self._loaded = True

    def _sorted(self) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
        return sorted(self.rows, key=_sort_key)

    def add(self, r: Dict[str, Any]) -> None:
        cid = r["id"]
        if cid in self.idx:
            oi = self.idx[cid]
            for k in COLS:
                if k != "id" and k in r:
                    r[k] = self.rows[oi].get(k, "")
                if k == "valor":
                    r["valor"] = _try_num_br(r["valor"])
                if k == "data":
                    r["data"] = _safe_dt(r["data"]) or date(1970, 1, 1)
            self.rows[oi] = r
            self.idx[cid] = len(self.rows) - 1
            return
        self.rows.append(r)
        self.unique.add(cid)
        self.idx[cid] = len(self.rows) - 1

    def remove_by_id(self, cid: str) -> bool:
        if cid not in self.idx:
            return False
        pos = self.idx.pop(cid)
        del self.rows[pos]
        for k in list(self.idx.keys()):
            if self.idx[k] > pos:
                self.idx[k] -= 1
        self.unique = {v for v in self.idx.values()}
        return True

    # ----------------------------------------------- parse de datas
    @staticmethod
    def _safe_dt(s: str) -> Optional[date]:
        s = str(s).strip()
        m = re.match(r"^(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2})$", s)
        if m:
            try: return date(int(m.group(1)), int(m.group(2)), int(m.group(3)))
            except Exception: pass
        m = re.match(r"^(\d{2})[\/](\d{2})[\/](\d{4})$", s)
        if m:
            try:
                d, mm, y = int(m.group(1)), int(m.group(2)), int(m.group(3))
                if 1 <= d <= 31 and 1 <= mm <= 12:
                    return date(y, mm, d)
            except Exception: pass
        m = re.match(r"^(\d{2})[\/](\d{2})[\/](\d{2})$", s)
        if m:
            try:
                a, b, c = int(m.group(1)), int(m.group(2)), int(m.group(3))
                if 1 <= a <= 12 and 1 <= b <= 12:
                    return date(2000 if a <= 59 else 1900 + 100 * ((a // 10) % 100) + (a % 10) * 10, b, a)
            except Exception: pass
        return None

    # ----------------------------------------------- amostra inicial
    @staticmethod
    def _bootsample():
        """~160 lançamentos fictícios plausíveis, distribuídos em até ~6 meses."""
        DESC = [
            "Recebimento de serviço autônomo", "Venda de mercadoria", "Reembolso de despesa",

            "Entrada do imóvel", "Medicamentos contínuos", "Delivery da semana",
            "Estacionamento e pedágio", "Consulta médica", "Livros técnicos",
            "Jogo eletrônico", "Bares e restaurantes", "Aplicativo de música",
            "Passagem de ônibus", "Manutenção do notebook", "Taxa de condomínio",
            "Internet fibra", "Financiamento veicular", "Presente de aniversário",
            "Frete de encomendas", "Seguro do carro", "Consultoria financeira",
            "Workshop de investimentos", "Revisão do veículo", "Tarifas bancárias",
            "Transferência via TED", "Domingo na praia",

            "Pneus e alinhamento", "Honorários contábeis", "Corretagem de seguros",

        ]
        SUB = {

            "Moradia": ["Aluguel", "Energia", "Água", "Internet", "Condomínio"],

        FORMAS = ["Pix", "Boleto bancário", "Dinheiro", "Transferência bancária",
                  "Cartão de débito", "Cartão de crédito", "QR Code", "Débito automático"]
        CENTROS = ["Pessoal", "Moradia", "Transporte", "Saúde", "Educação", "Lazer",
                    "Investimentos", "Finanças", "Impostos", "Reserva"]

        rows = []
        for _ in range(160):
            tipo = "receita" if _rand_u() < 0.30 else "despesa"
            off = _rand_int(30, 190)

            if cand < date.today() - timedelta(days=190):

                fonte = ("Freelance" if _rand_u() < 0.16
                         else "13º salário" if _rand_u() < 0.22
                         else "Pro-labore" if _rand_u() < 0.55
                         else "Restituição do IR" if _rand_u() < 0.14
                         else "Outros recebimentos")
                sub, cat = fonte, "Trabalho"
            else:
                cat = _choice(list(SUB.items())[1])
                sub = _choice(SUB[cat])
                v = _rand_val(10, 15000)
            rows.append({
                "id": str(int(_lcg() * 10_000_000_000)),
                "categoria": cat, "subcategoria": sub,
                "descricao": _choice(DESC),

            })
        if rows:
            with self.path.open("w", encoding="utf-8", newline="") as fh:
                writer = csv.writer(fh, delimiter=",", quoting=csv.QUOTE_MINIMAL, lineterminator="\r\n")
                writer.writerow(COLS)
                for r in rows:
                    def _o(k):
                        if k == "valor": return _fmt_moeda(r[k])
